chapter_notes_tr: Final bölüm. Beş kişilik ana savaş düzeni korunur; 1-1 dışındaki standart çatışmalar beş oynanabilir savaşçıyla yürür. 7-5 bossundan sonra önce duygusal itiraf, ardından Part I twist sahnesi oynar.

scenes.direction_en: A stairway descends through the mountain into the altar. Seven chains cross the passage; each bears the seven-notched gray seal that Yseldra left on Mahmut's shield. Nixie returns with Jori and Odelia.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ch7_altar (uneasy layer), chains as percussion | post: bgm_ledger_motif (seven notes, then silence where the eighth should be)

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Enemy intent icons preview their next action. Set the Auto policy to interrupt a charging Elite; your standard five-person formation always remains two Front and three Rear slots.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: I brought the people from Oakhaven as far as the lower pass. They are safe. I am not staying behind again.
These links came from my family's forge. We were told they were made for a royal bridge.
They were made to hold something in place. The question is what the crown was afraid would move.
The chain-bearers up there sing to it. They think the eclipse is holding its breath for the kingdom.
We find the answer together. No one goes ahead alone.
You say that as if I am the one who keeps trying to disappear.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The hammer marks are mine. My grandmother's, before me. We repaired these chains after the first eclipse.
Then your family tried to mend a wound it did not make.
We made a cage and called it a bridge. My hands will not make that mistake again.
The marks point down. We can be sad after we stop the thing below.

scenes.battle_transition_en: The upper chain breaks. Below it, a bell rings once without moving its clapper.

scenes.direction_en: At a fork in the stair, companions who escorted refugees return from the outer route. They do not replace the player's formation; they create a brief, scripted diversion while the five-person party advances.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_held_the_road — full ensemble statement | post: bgm_held_the_road (comic tag for the barricade line)

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Auto Battle follows your target policy. Prioritize marked threats, protect the healer, or focus the weakest enemy; formation and equipment still matter.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The refugees are through. I told the guards to bar the road behind us.
And I told them the barricade was my idea. They believed me because I looked proud of it.
Two sentinels are winding up a flank attack. Mahmut, your left side is about to become very popular.
You have already done enough. Get everyone home.
Then come back so I can tell you that in person.

post_battle_lines.text_en: Outer stair is held! Mostly because my barricade is now on fire, but held is held.
The road is ours. Go finish what we began.
When this is over, I want to hear every detail of that barricade.
When this is over. I will keep borrowing those words until there are none left.

scenes.direction_en: A round archive is carved into the stairwell. Aveline, Mirel, Clem, Pippa and Kera rebuild the erased record from copied names, bell rubbings and Jori's forge marks.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ledger_motif under the voices reading names | post: bgm_fadyme_theme with choir when the name is written back; this is the emotional peak before the boss

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: The Silence Field delays Focus gain. Protect the record scribe or destroy the field anchor; your five equipped heroes remain the battle team.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The ledger was written over, not burned. Someone needed the names to remain beneath the ink.
I can read the prayer beneath it. The names were offered as witnesses, not sacrifices.
I came here to be offered. They are asking me to be witnessed.
Witnesses to what?
To a promise. The last line says, 'Let the lost hour be remembered by the living.'
There is one space scraped clean. It is the same length as Fadyme's name.
Then write it back. A name should not vanish just because someone feared what it meant.
I will sing it while you write. The page will not dare lose its place.

post_battle_lines.text_en: Give me the pen. My hand helped erase it. This time, my hand writes it back.
Fadyme Veyr. The record accepts the ink.
Veyr?
My mother's name. It was hers before it was mine.
I am sorry. I wanted one more quiet day before you knew even this much.

scenes.direction_en: At the altar's outer ring, the returned companions raise wards and open an evacuation path. The five-person core party faces the last sentinels while distant friends hold the side lanes in a non-playable set piece.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_held_the_road → bgm_tension | post: sting_bell_toll (the pulse stops)

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Set Auto Ultimate to 'Boss only' to save Focus for the next phase, or 'Use when ready' for faster clears. The side altar's pulse resolves at the end of the displayed round.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The east passage is clear. I left a lantern at every turn; nobody gets lost in the dark tonight.
The altar is counting backward. It has mistaken a bell for a clock.
The eastern anchor is mine. Hana, take the evacuees through the lantern path.
I will. And Fadyme—I kept my promise. Come back, so I can stop keeping it.
I promise to try.
You do not have to promise alone.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The pulse is stopped. The altar is open.
Mahmut, after this, stay beside me. Just for a little while.
As long as you ask me to.
I do not know how to ask for forever. I will ask for one more step.

scenes.battle_transition_en: The companions seal the side altar. Mahmut and Fadyme pass through the inner gate with their four chosen allies.

scenes.direction_en: Five heroes enter a circular chamber beneath a suspended black sun. A crownless, clockwork guardian unfolds from the altar. During the battle, the VN camera returns briefly between phases to show Fadyme hiding the ash-dark veins spreading past her wrist.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ch7_altar (chaotic layer) | battle: bgm_boss_eclipse_construct (phase 1, phase 2 adds choir and the bell motif) | post: silence after 'HOUR... STILL OWED.'

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Phase I: Stone attacks break the Construct's chain joints. Guard against Crownfall Sweep when its core glows red.
Phase II: destroy the three pylons to weaken Aether Ward. Cleanse, shield, or heal the hero marked by Decay Brand before Eclipse Pulse.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Five of us. We have broken worse lines than this.
And if the altar asks for a name?
It can have mine first.
No. We leave with all five names. That is the only answer I will accept.

phase_interludes.direction_en: The chain joints split. The Construct falls to one knee. Fadyme presses a darkening hand beneath her cloak before Mahmut turns.

lines.text_en: THE HOUR IS UNPAID.
Then stop asking the living to pay it.

phase_interludes.direction_en: The three pylons ignite. Black-gold lines crawl over Fadyme's fingers; she closes her fist and keeps her voice even.

lines.text_en: The ward is using the bearer as its anchor! Break the pylons!
Fadyme, stay behind me!
I am right here. Finish it with me.

post_battle_lines.text_en: WITNESS... RESTORED. HOUR... STILL OWED.
It is over.
Fadyme? Your hand—
I am only tired. Please, Mahmut. Not here.
The dark has reached my heart. I cannot make it wait much longer.

scenes.battle_transition_en: The chamber falls silent. Fadyme tries to walk, then collapses. The surviving heroes carry her to the altar's outer dais.

scenes.direction_en: Two quiet days later. Mahmut and Fadyme reach the crater rim. Below, an eclipse hangs over seven broken chains.
scenes.music_cue: bgm_ch7_altar (distant, calm layer) — two quiet days; wind over the crater

lines.text_en: It is beautiful. That is the worst part.
When this is done, we will find somewhere ugly and safe.
With cheese.
With cheese.
He believes the machine is the curse. Tomorrow he learns it is only the hand that holds the pen.
Below them, at the foot of the stair, a small lantern light moved. Their friends were already there.

after_battle_scenes.title_en: The Words He Did Not Know
after_battle_scenes.direction_en: Battle UI dissolves to a still VN composition: Mahmut kneels beside Fadyme under the dim eclipse. The others wait beyond a broken arch, close enough to help but giving them privacy. The narration is quiet; no music for the first exchange.
after_battle_scenes.music_cue: silence for the first lines; bgm_fadyme_theme enters on piano only when Mahmut first speaks her name; no percussion anywhere in this scene

lines.text_en: All this time, you were carrying something alone.
I thought if I smiled, the curse would have to wait its turn.
You should have told me.
I know. I wanted to be more than the person you were trying to save.
You are. You are the person who made every road feel like it led somewhere.
Then let me ask for one selfish thing. Stay until I fall asleep.
I will stay when you wake, too.
You still do not understand. I am dying, Mahmut. The curse is taking my hours one by one.
Then I will find the hand that wrote this curse. I will not let it write the last line.
I was afraid you would look at me and see a final hour.
I see you. I should have seen you sooner.
You did not know. That is why I could keep pretending.
Then I have one more thing to confess. I knew Yseldra. I saw her call you to the altar that night, and I told you I did not know her.
I know. I heard it in the cathedral. We were both pretending, Mahmut. Let us stop together.
For one breath, the eclipse above them thinned. Fadyme's fingers found Mahmut's, and the darkness beneath her skin did not retreat.

after_battle_scenes.direction_en: A reflection moves in the altar's polished black stone after the others leave. A man in a travel-stained chancellor's coat steps through it, carrying a watch with no hands. Yseldra appears in the reflected archway, her veil lifted for the first time.
after_battle_scenes.music_cue: bgm_clockless — full statement: pizzicato that never resolves; cut to silence on 'Uncle.'; bgm_main_theme over the ending card

lines.text_en: You have finally told him the truth. How considerate of you to wait until the hour was nearly gone.
Show yourself.
Lord Cael Veyr. The Clockless Chancellor, if titles still comfort anyone.
Uncle.
You were dead.
The court recorded my death. It did not record where my missing hour went.
You made her curse.
I made a door. Yseldra chose who would stand in it.
Do not mistake him for your answer, Fadyme. He only knows how to turn grief into a bargain.
Come to the Clockless Court, Mahmut. I can return the hours the curse has taken. The price is one hour that belongs to you.
And if I refuse?
Then she keeps fading, and you keep learning what 'too late' means.
Mahmut, do not answer him tonight.
The handless watch ticked once. Somewhere below the altar, a bell answered.

after_battle_scenes.next_part_teaser_en: Part II — The Hours We Have Left
